description: This file defines a SecureWebServer class for an Android application, implementing an HTTPS server that serves a simple webpage with an embedded image. It handles SSL context creation, socket management, and HTTP response generation.

classes.name: SecureWebServer
classes.description: A class implementing a simple HTTPS web server for Android, supporting SSL setup and serving a static webpage with an embedded image.

methods.name: SecureWebServer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes SSL context and prepares the server, loading key material from assets.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the server on a separate thread, listening on port 8080, and serves responses to incoming connections.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the server and closes the SSL socket.

methods.name: createBase64Image
methods.description: Reads an image from assets and encodes it into a base64 string for embedding.
